title: Kerrghan's music pack
description: This pack edits minecraft music disks to a personal selection
body:
I made this pack for my friends and myself, but it can be used and edited as seen fit.

This pack works on 1.20 and should work on all 1.19 version, though I didn't test it in a while.

Some songs are video game songs, so I translated the titles for English (en_us) and French (fr_fr).

There are 2 versions of the pack:

The default version

Works like vanilla minecraft, you hear the songs up to a certain distance and you hear where the music comes from.

The unlimited edition

This one has unlimited range, not recommended on servers and is significantly louder than the normal version so whatch out!

Rights:

I do not own any of the songs, all credit goes to de original artists!

Also these songs might not be copyright free, use at own risk!
